source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia
source.method: enwiki: Lunar phase, Blue moon, Supermoon, Harvest moon, Lunar eclipse, Moon illusion

looks_like.reverse: Which phase or famous moon is this? {value}

rows.label: New Moon
rows.looks_like: Dark and invisible: the sunlit side faces away from us

rows.label: Waxing Crescent
rows.looks_like: A thin sliver lit on the right, growing night by night (northern sky)

rows.label: First Quarter
rows.looks_like: A half disc with the right side lit, a week after the dark one (northern sky)

rows.label: Waxing Gibbous
rows.looks_like: Mostly lit but a dent still dark on the left, getting rounder (northern sky)

rows.label: Full Moon
rows.looks_like: A complete bright disc, rising as the sun sets

rows.label: Waning Gibbous
rows.looks_like: Mostly lit with a dent growing dark on the right (northern sky)

rows.label: Last Quarter
rows.looks_like: A half disc with the left side lit (northern sky)

rows.label: Waning Crescent
rows.looks_like: A thin sliver lit on the left, shrinking toward darkness (northern sky)

rows.label: Blue Moon
rows.looks_like: Looks ordinary, not blue: by the common rule, the second full disc in one calendar month

rows.label: Supermoon
rows.looks_like: A bright disc that looks a bit larger because it is at its closest to Earth

rows.label: Harvest Moon
rows.looks_like: The bright disc nearest the autumn equinox, rising low and orange

rows.label: Blood Moon
rows.looks_like: A disc turned coppery red while Earth's shadow covers it

rows.label: Moon Illusion
rows.looks_like: A disc that seems huge near the horizon but is the same size overhead
